### Read the Bible – Deut. 23, Psalms 112—113, Isaiah 50, and Revelation 20
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deut-23-psalms-112-113-isaiah-50-revelation-20/
Passage: Deuteronomy 23:24-25
Points:
- Biblical civil law models a wise balance that avoids the extremes of rigid capitalism and total collectivism.
- Permitting neighbors to eat their fill on the spot fosters community interdependence and softens strict property barriers.
- The rule ensures immediate relief for the hungry without placing an excessive burden on any single landowner.
- Forbidding the use of baskets or sickles deters theft and protects incentives for disciplined personal labor.
- God's statutes consistently reflect a healthy harmony between generous social welfare and the protection of private property.
